Scalar registrations loop rows inside worker, vectorized registrations call per chunk, queued native path splits submit collect phases queued chunk tasks can submitted grouped result collection. Main-thread RIPC callbacks now cooperatively drain queued worker callbacks submit/collect wave, avoiding single-request timeout path parallel DuckDB UDF execution. rducks_explain_udf() now reports queue-pending, RIPC--flight, RIPC submit/collect wave counters diagnosing whether chunks actually overlapping. Arrow IPC encoding nanoarrow arrays now uses native buffer writer instead R rawConnection, avoiding large transient allocations. Enum arguments returns supported explicit Rducks enum-storage IPC convention. Execution plans now carry concrete engine_id (example arrow_c_direct_serial, arrow_c_direct_main_queue, ipc_future_pool), rducks_as_execution_plan() accepts engine-id shortcuts preserving existing marshalling + concurrency API. rducks_inproc_stats() now reports main-thread drain attempts, non-empty drain batches, maximum drain batch size addition pending/running queue pressure timeout semantics. SQL execution-backend setter now requires recorded main-thread capability carried Rducks’ R wrapper, main-thread token can longer rebound different token initialization. Manual SQL calls bare backend string fail instead mutating runtime execution state. Dev/test-SQL probes (rducks_parallel_range, rducks_parallel_thread_probe, rducks_queue_self_test, rducks_thread_is_main) now registered RDUCKS_DEV_SURFACES=true set extension load. Production SQL surfaces keep registration, execution, documented statistics helpers. Direct arrow_c scalar/vectorized execution Arrow/R + Arrow IPC callback paths fenced R_tryCatchError() plus R_UnwindProtect() unexpected marshalling/allocation errors converted DuckDB UDF errors without installing fresh R top-level context inside DuckDB callbacks. RIPC cleanup now releases preserved Future/schema objects decrements -flight counters abnormal unwind. Arrow C Data result import now copies temporary imported DuckDB vector callback-owned output vector destroying imported chunk, avoiding reliance reference-vector lifetime semantics. Added direct native arrow_c vectorized UDF support (RCV) signatures accepted direct arrow_c type matrix. Chunk arguments materialized DuckDB vectors C, return rows written back direct writer, generated marshalling coverage verifies path fall back Arrow/R helpers. Added internal %||% compatibility shim package works lowered R 4.3 dependency floor. arrow_c now direct scalar vectorized marshalling path. Unsupported signatures fail explicitly instead falling back Arrow/R helper marshalling. Added rducks_release_stats() inspect process-local counters preserved R objects queued -main DuckDB metadata destructors drained later recorded main R thread. Added rducks_runtime_stats() inspect native runtime registry extension-owned connection accounting. Added R-universe badge README lowered package R dependency floor R 4.3. Removed per-registration evaluator selection rducks_register(). evaluator now derived active execution plan, conformance tests compare plan-native registrations instead mixing evaluator choices inside single registration call. Added mode = "vectorized" R UDFs called per DuckDB chunk vector/list-column arguments. vectorized adapter uses Arrow C Data/nanoarrow bridge scalar mode, enforces return length, defines default vs special NULL handling, covered runtime tests.
